names.note: Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 22. јул ст. ст., „Преп. Корнилије Перејаславски.“, with «Преп.» — the rank — left off by §6. **«Перејаславски» IS KEPT AND IS THE WHOLE OF WHY THIS FORM LANDS IN NO FOLD**: it is neither a rank nor a see, he is a monk and holds no see, and the bare «Корнилије» is already held in sr by `cornelius-the-centurion`. `sr-foldnew.mjs` answered `keys: 2` with `holders: 0 (none)` for both, and `foldchk.py` `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`. The form is the nominative the heading itself prints. No Romanian, Greek or Russian form is written: none of those books was opened for him, and the Russian calendar is the one most likely to hold him, which is said in this batch’s commit message.

Name page 1287 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Корнилий Переяславский, прп.»: the rank is stripped and the place kept. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE — the folder's Serbian form spells the place with ј and folds elsewhere.

death.note: Охридски пролог: „Пред смрт примио схиму и упокојио се 22. јула 1693. године.“

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 июля ст. ст. — «Прп. Корнилия Переяславского (1693).»

attestations.note: The day's third entry and the same menologion day as the folder's Serbian row, which is the only other venerated row it carries. «Прп.» is the `venerable` the folder's `types` already carry. `dates` UNCHANGED and the two sources AGREE EXACTLY: this line gives «(1693)» and the Ohrid Prologue gives 22 July 1693. The spelling differs between the two books — the Serbian form is «Перејаславски» and this calendar writes «Переяславский», which is why the Russian form is stored beside the Serbian and not instead of it. The reading life4288 was NOT opened, the folder's life being already written from the Prologue. TWO HYMNS TAKEN where the folder had none, and THE KONTAKION IS WHY HE IS CALLED SILENT: it has him lay silence upon his lips so as not to speak vanity, and sing to God with an unsilent heart.
Not checked: doxologia.ro’s calendar for 22 iulie, which is the page for this menologion number — not 4 august, which merely shares his civil date in 2026.

Not checked: saint.gr’s εορτολόγιο for 22 Ιουλίου, which is the page for this menologion number. The corpus holds five folders on that number already and none of them is a Russian monk of the seventeenth century.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.08.2026 (22. јул ст. ст.) — „Преп. Корнилије Перејаславски.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (§4), and the only new folder of the day. **«Преп.» is the `venerable` this folder takes and the heading’s only rank word.** **THREE TYPES ARE REFUSED AND ALL THREE ARE IN THE BODY.** „У 15. години замонаши се од старца Павла.“, in his fifteenth year he was MADE A MONK by the elder Павле, which is Монах by §5 and is not in the heading; „Доцније се повукао у пустињу на молчаније.“, later he withdrew INTO THE DESERT for silence, which would be Пустињак; and „Постом себе је тако исушио, да је личио на костур.“, by fasting he had dried himself out so far that he was like a skeleton, which would be Испосник. A rank read out of a body is not written, so `types` is `venerable` and nothing else. **THE GREAT SCHEMA HE RECEIVED BEFORE DEATH IS NOT A TYPE EITHER** and this vocabulary has no word for it. **ONE DATE, STATED TO THE DAY, AND THE FIELD IS NEW BECAUSE THE FOLDER IS.** „Пред смрт примио схиму и упокојио се 22. јула 1693. године.“ — before his death he received the schema and reposed on the 22nd of July 1693. `death` earliest 1693, latest 1693, display «1693», basis traditional. **The day of death the book gives is the menologion day of this very entry**, 22 July, which is the ordinary case and not a second feast. **NO `birth`, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS REFUSED TWICE.** The entry gives his age at tonsure, fifteen, and the length of his silence, thirty years. Neither is a date, and a birth year got by subtracting either from 1693 would be this reading computing a fact rather than reading one — the same refusal the twenty-seven years of Ezekiel’s prophecy took on the day before. **NO FOLD, AND §6 IS WHY FOR THE SECOND TIME TODAY.** `sr-foldnew.mjs` answered `keys: 2` with `holders: 0 (none)` for both keys of «Корнилије Перејаславски», and `foldchk.py` `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`. **The bare «Корнилије» is held in sr by `cornelius-the-centurion`**, so the toponymic the heading prints is the whole of what keeps this form out of a fold. «Перејаславски» is neither a rank nor a see — he is a monk and holds no see — so §6 keeps it: it is a by-name and the fullest form this calendar gives him. **NO `related` AND NO FOLDER FOR THE ELDER WHO TONSURED HIM, ON RULING 3.** `ls saints | grep -i ’^paul’` returns more than twenty folders and `sr-namesweep.mjs` returned nothing but Cornelii; not one Paul read here is an elder of a Pereslavl house in the seventeenth century, and an identification off a bare forename is not an identification. **AND THE CORPUS’S FOUR OTHER CORNELII ARE NOT HIM**: `cornelius-of-komel` 1455 to 1537, `cornelius-of-paleostrov` dead 1420, `cornelius-of-pskov` 1501 to 1570 and `cornelius-the-centurion` of the Acts. The nearest in kind, the abbot of the Pskov Caves, died a hundred and twenty-three years before this man. `grep -rilE ’pereslavl|perejaslav|pereyaslav’ saints/*/saint.json` returns eight folders and `daniel-of-pereslavl` is the only monastic of the town among them; he is not this man and no row is made. No `office`: the heading gives none and the book names no house. No `locations`: Pereslavl is in the by-name and the desert is not a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only Bishop Nikolai’s verse, and **that verse is on Mary Magdalene alone** — twenty-six lines of it — **and says nothing of this man, of Phocas or of Marcella**, which was read before it was said.

hymns.text: Новоявленнаго угодника Божия почтим,/ Корнилия преподобнаго,/ крест на рамо вземшаго,/ иго Христово усердно понесшаго,/ иже на невидимыя враги мужественно подвизався/ и козни их поправ, яко добр воин,/ Владыце Христу предста и молится о душах наших.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь преподобного Корнилия Переяславского», глас 8

english.text: Let us honour the newly manifest servant of God, Cornelius the venerable, who took the cross upon his shoulder and bore the yoke of Christ with zeal, who contended manfully against the unseen enemies and, trampling down their devices as a good soldier, stood before Christ the Master and prays for our souls.

hymns.text: Вышняя получити желая,/ в Вышних Живущему неленостно поработал еси, блаженне,/ да наследиши Горняя, презрел еси дольняя,/ не токмо очи отвратив, не видети суеты,/ но и устнама твоима молчание наложив, не глаголати суетная,/ обаче немолчным сердцем воспел еси Богу./ Не умолчи убо и ныне, о нас моляся,/ Корнилие преподобне.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 июля ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Корнилия Переяславского», глас 2

english.text: Desiring to obtain the things on high, thou didst labour untiringly for Him who dwells on high, O blessed one; that thou mightest inherit the things above, thou didst despise the things below, not only turning thine eyes away so as not to see vanity, but laying silence upon thy lips so as not to speak vain things, and yet singing to God with an unsilent heart. Be not silent now either, but pray for us, O venerable Cornelius.
